corrections.superseded_note: the override is ADDITIVE in u_fast (the old edge is superseded in the ledger, not deleted), so old keys are expected to keep transmitting; the without-destroying criterion is counted on the UNTOUCHED facts
corrections.probe_identity_note: diagnostic only, not gated: the NNFS update is additive in u_fast, so an unrelated answer string can shift without any fact being destroyed; the without-destroying gate counts STRENGTHS (untouched facts intact)

transcript_purge.note: RETRIEVED is expected to degrade after a purge (the transcript WAS its substrate); PLASTIC must not move — that is the whole test
